self_check.tolerance: scores within 0.0005 (alarm_log stores 3 decimals); alarms, named buses and type exact

scenarios.title: Normal operation
scenarios.note: A clean snapshot. GridDefense should stay quiet.

scenarios.title: Voltage + angle bias at the central substation
scenarios.note: Additive attack, 2% at bus 4 (132 kV hub, 5 lines).

scenarios.title: Voltage scaling at the city substation
scenarios.note: Scaling attack, −1.5% on the voltage reading at bus 9 (capacitor bank).

scenarios.title: Coordinated attack, city and industrial park
scenarios.note: The same bias at two connected buses, so they agree with each other.

scenarios.title: Coordinated attack on the northern 33 kV area
Small bias at the harbour
scenarios.note: 1% — the lower end of the trained range.

scenarios.title: Stealth test: very small bias
scenarios.note: 0.5% — below the trained range. Expected to be hard to detect.

scenarios.title: Stealth test: tiny scaling
scenarios.note: 0.25% — close to the meter noise. Shows the system's limit.
